_doc: Edit freely. delegates[].aa is the Artificial Analysis slug (effort suffix included; the bare slug is the max-effort run).

pools are ids from quota.py: claude-5h, claude-7d, codex-5h, codex-7d, cursor-auto, cursor-premium. cursor-auto is Cursor's whole Auto + 'Cursor Models' (Grok, Composer) pool: openusage plan_auto_percent_used = their spend / $450 (verified 2026-10-10).
prior: hand-set stand-in numbers for models AA does not rate; aa_proxy: true means `aa` is a stand-in model's rating, not the delegate's own.
prefer: list (all tasks) or {task: [delegate ids...]}; preferred delegates that clear min_quota rank first in listed order.
tasks[].weights apply to intelligence, coding, speed (output tok/s) and price (cheaper scores higher; inside a subscription it approximates how fast a model drains its pool).
orchestrator_cost.list_prices: dated standard/global API list prices in USD per million tokens, used as a subscription accounting unit, not a bill; unsplit cache writes use the 5m rate.

list_prices.source: claude-api skill table cached 2026-10-06; Opus/Haiku 5.5 cross-checked against LiteLLM on 2026-10-13.

delegates.notes: Proven 2026-10-09 (eu-pd-composers). Follows brief constraints literally: check its dry-run output against real data.
Codex config default. AA price is 5x Sol, so expect it to drain the Codex pool faster.
Faster, cheaper OpenAI option for mechanical work.

Default Cursor delegate. Auto routes to SpaceX in-house models (Cursor is SpaceX-owned) and is the most cost-efficient Cursor option; rated with Grok 4.7 High as a stand-in. Named Grok and Composer models share this pool (see cursor-grok).

Grok and Composer bill Cursor's "Cursor Models" quota, which shares the Auto pool and its openusage metric (plan_auto_percent_used = Auto + Grok + Composer spend / $450, checked at two snapshots 2026-10-10); not premium/API. Field data 2026-10-10: grok-4.7-low labelled 6.5k rows (0 failures, ~576 tok/label) for ~2.7 pts of the pool. Real model ids: grok-4.7-{low,medium,high,xhigh}[-fast].
Agent tool with model=sonnet. Shares the orchestrator's own Claude quota. Effort level assumed (high).
Agent tool with model=haiku. Cheap and fast; shares the orchestrator's Claude quota.

review.desc: read a diff/codebase and report defects

implement.desc: new features or fixes from a brief

research.desc: investigate a question, read docs/data, write findings
